title: fix(objectql)!: a non-system write may name, in a lookup or user field, only a record the caller can read
body:
security#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvynRbCtMndW8EHNGc

Fixes #29029

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — the write's reference check narrows: a non-system `lookup` or `user` value naming a record the caller cannot read is refused, and an update's forgiveness of a value the row already stores compares only stored values the caller may read. The business-unit read widens: a delegated admin reads the business units inside the admin scope it holds, and no other.
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches a reference to a record its writer cannot read, a delegate's business-unit read, or an update's carried-back reference (a grep of `skills/` for `reference_not_found`, `already stores` and `not judged again` finds only the permission-set catalog refusal, unchanged); `content/docs` states the rule on four pages (below).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：非系统写在 `lookup` / `user` 字段里只能引用调用方自己读得到的记录，读不到的一律答 `reference_not_found`（与 `master_detail` 同一条规则），且先于记录校验规则；委派管理员可读其 adminScope 覆盖的业务单元。本 PR 在 #30747 之上再加一条：更新时「行里已存的值不再判」这条宽免，只比对调用方读得到的已存值，调用方可改不可读的列不宽免任何值。
- 为什么改：裁决 6663849489（A 重申 + 委派读）；宽免一条由安全席位要求与本规则同时落地。
- 风险与回滚：BREAKING 收窄。依赖「引用读不到的记录」的非系统写会被拒；可改不可读的引用列上，更新带回原值也按新值判。读得到该列的调用方照旧宽免，系统写（种子、安装、启动）不变。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine-referential-integrity.ts` 的 `storedReferencesCallerReads` 与 `assertReferencesResolve` 末段；`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`（三条写路径的顺序）；`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts` 的 `delegatedUnitReadScope`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/reference-forgiveness-readable-column.test.ts`，预期 26/26 绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

> [!WARNING]
> **BREAKING** — accept-set narrowing at the write's reference check (`@objectstack/objectql`), served by every write door. After the upgrade, a write that is not a system write is refused `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` with the field's localized `reference_not_found` when a `lookup` or `user` value it supplies names a record the caller cannot read; and an update's forgiveness of a value the row already stores compares only stored values the caller may read.

**Supersedes #30747** (closed with a pointer to this PR). A continuation by the security seat (security#1, session_01L9qibvynRbCtMndW8EHNGc): #30747's head `0e54448624` on a new branch, `main` merged three times, and the forgiveness rule below added at the same time, as #30747 itself continued #30672. #30747 carries a contract review PASS at `0e54448624` and the maintainer's per-PR BREAKING word; the seat retires #30747 with a pointer here.

## What changes

**The rule.** A write that is not a system write may name, in a `lookup`, `user` or `master_detail` field, only a record its caller's own read door returns. An unreadable reference target always answers `reference_not_found`, before the record's validation rules. A record the caller cannot read answers exactly as a record that exists nowhere, and so does one whose read by the caller fails. System writes (`isSystem`) stay exempt, keep the order they had and give the answer they gave; a flow run's elevated write keeps its existence check. A reference to an object the registry does not hold is not judged. `tree` keeps the existence check alone. A `lookup` or `user` value naming a user the caller cannot read answers `reference_not_found` and its ban is not asked; a user the caller can read is judged for its ban as before (#30205).

**The forgiveness (new on this PR).** An update that carries back a `master_detail`, `lookup` or `user` value the row already stores is still not judged again (#29062), by id and in bulk ("every matched row stores it") alike, but the update's reference forgiveness compares only stored values the caller may read: the stored rows as the caller's own read door serves them, each column kept only where it is served exactly as stored. A column the caller may edit but not read (a field permission `readable: false, editable: true`) holds no stored value for it, so it forgives nothing: a value named there is judged like any other, and the answer is the same whatever the column holds. A caller who can read the column keeps the forgiveness. A system write compares the rows as stored, as before. A failed read of the stored row forgives nothing.

**The delegate read.** An admin scope over a business-unit subtree (ADR-0090 D12) grants read on the business units inside that subtree, and on no unit outside it. It applies to a read of `sys_business_unit` that the caller's own permission sets do not grant, on the caller's own behalf, bounded to the union of the subtrees the caller's held scopes cover. A caller with a `sys_business_unit` grant reads as that grant says, as before.

- `packages/objectql/src/engine-referential-integrity.ts` — `lookup` and `user` join `master_detail` on the caller's read door; `referencesCheckedBeforeRules`, the one predicate every write door and the validate preview read for the order; **new:** `storedReferencesCallerReads`, the stored rows the forgiveness compares against, read once per refusing write through the caller's read door and kept per column by `servedAsStored` (the comparison the `update`-mode validate preview already makes for its stored row).
- `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`, `engine-validate.ts` — insert, update by id, bulk update and the validate preview check references before the record's validation rules unless the write is a system write; the reference check's host gains `find`.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-references-and-master-detail.ts`, `engine-master-detail-related.ts` — the caller-readable reference helpers (`callerReadableReferenceExists`, and `callerReadableReferenceRow` for the user reference whose ban is also asked), and the #18682 docblock now states the rule.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-gate.ts`, `security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` — `scopedBusinessUnitIds` and `delegatedUnitReadScope`; the middleware admits the read and narrows it to `id IN` the scoped units.
- `packages/verify/src/parent-write-reach.ts` — the parent-write-reach verifier's personas read every record of each object a probed detail's required reference names outside its master chain, so the create probe names records its writer can read.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` — `records-forms.predicate-relationship-traversal` takes revision 7, written to the rule.
- `content/docs/api/error-catalog.mdx`, `content/docs/data-modeling/fields.mdx`, `content/docs/permissions/delegated-administration.mdx` — each states the rule where a sentence would otherwise have gone false; the first two now also say the forgiveness compares only stored values the caller may read.
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` — row 23 says where a system write's reference check runs and that a system write compares an update's stored rows as stored; its Symbol cell and the generated site register name `referencesCheckedBeforeRules` and `storedReferencesCallerReads`.
- `.changeset/29029-lookup-user-caller-read.md` — `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/plugin-security` and `@objectstack/verify`, patch, BREAKING; amended with the forgiveness paragraph and the widened `Clause-②:` line.

## Tests

- **New:** `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/reference-forgiveness-readable-column.test.ts` (26) — the real engine and the real security plugin. For `lookup`, `user` and `master_detail`, by id and in bulk over two rows: in a column the caller may edit but not read, a value the rows store and one they do not answer byte-identically (status, code, field finding and sentence, with the sent id written out) and the rows are untouched; controls — the same grant edits another column of the same rows; a caller who can read the column has the stored value carried back land and a new unreadable value refused; a system write keeps its exemption.
- **New block:** `packages/objectql/src/engine-unreadable-reference-target.test.ts` (now 113) — a top-level describe on the same rig: a middleware withholds the reference columns from the caller's reads of the row; `lookup` and `user`, by id and in bulk, the stored value answers as another unreadable value; a failed read of the stored row forgives nothing; controls — a column the caller reads keeps the forgiveness; a flow run's system write compares the rows as stored.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-unreadable-reference-target.test.ts` (#30747's 99): `lookup` and `user` × insert / batch insert / update by id / bulk update — an unreadable target is refused as one that exists nowhere; a refused read of the target object answers the same; a multi-valued field with one unreadable member; a system write; a stored value carried back; the read door before the elevated probe. On all four doors and for `lookup`, `user` and `master_detail`, an unreadable reference answers `reference_not_found` before the record's validation rules while a readable one reaches them; the validate preview agrees; the order controls for system and flow-run writes; a read of the target that fails is refused; a reference to an unregistered object is admitted.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/delegated-admin-own-name-set.posture.test.ts` (33), three postures: a delegate reads exactly the units its scope covers (`find`, `findOne`, `count`); assigning a unit in scope is admitted; a unit outside the scope it cannot read is refused `reference_not_found`; controls — a writer with no scope, and an organization admin, unchanged.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/write-preview-field-gate-parity.test.ts`: the controls' callers read the related account; a new block drives the editor who cannot, and both doors answer the lookup's `reference_not_found`.
- Forced edits, rule-preserving (from #30747): six plugin-security suites provision `sys_user` with a row per user they name (`__tests__/rig-users.testkit.ts`); `agent-ceiling-grant-refusal` provisions the three users its grants name; `predicate-related-read-tenant-scope` counts the rule's related reads alone; four plugin-audit suites leave the write's id-only reference-check read out of their read counters.
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-banned-user-reference.test.ts` (11), `packages/verify/src/parent-write-reach.test.ts`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/predicate-relationship-traversal.dogfood.test.ts`: as on #30747.

<details><summary>Ablations of the forgiveness rule (this PR): through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, the comparison handed the rows as stored instead of as the caller reads them; restored blob equal to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty</summary>

The objectql pins import `./engine.js` from source and plugin-security's vitest aliases `@objectstack/objectql` to source, so the mutation is read from `src/`. Anchor `: await storedReferencesCallerReads.call(…)` x1 → x0, replacement `: storedAsStored;` x0 → x1, blob `6fc9b11c36b0` → `9bf670a3ec08`; restore blob `6fc9b11c36b0` == HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty, both legs.

1. `reference-forgiveness-readable-column.test.ts`: 6 failed | 20 passed (26) — exactly the identical-answer legs, `lookup` / `user` / `master_detail` × by id / bulk; every control green, the readable-column forgiveness among them.
2. `engine-unreadable-reference-target.test.ts`: 6 failed | 107 passed (113) — the hidden-column legs (`lookup`, `user` × by id / bulk) and the failed-read legs (`lookup`, `user`); the readable-column forgiveness and the flow-run controls green.

#30747's seven ablations stand as recorded there (on #30672 at `75a7c44d96`).

</details>

- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx` gains `storedReferencesCallerReads` in row 23 because the system-context census counts the forgiveness's one `isSystem` read; the register is regenerated by `check-system-context-census.mjs --write`.
- The rest as on #30747 (#30546 overlap and the two Test Core fixes on #30672).

## Acceptance notes

- `packages/services/service-automation/src/runas-system-reference-check.integration.test.ts` still names `masterDetailHeaderExists` in a comment, outside this card's surface.
- The delegate read covers a caller's own read; a read on another's behalf (`delegatorSets`) is not widened. Explain and `canReadObject` do not reflect the delegate read.
- The forgiveness's read of the stored rows runs only once a reference has been refused, one `find` for the write's rows, under the caller's context.
